title: native_parse test broken at HEAD: SERIAL=n on native_sim kills UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN -> LICHEN_NATIVE silently off
description: Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-at2y validation. lichen/tests/native_parse fails at HEAD on both worker8 (configure proceeds with warnings, compile dies: lichen/native.h not found) and pristine main checkout 8d7776e2fc (configure aborts on Kconfig warnings). Root cause chain: prj.conf sets CONFIG_UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN=y but SERIAL is not enabled, so the symbol falls back to n; LICHEN_NATIVE depends on UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN and silently turns off, so lichen/lib/native include dirs never reach the app. Fix: add CONFIG_SERIAL=y (and CONFIG_CONSOLE=y as needed) to tests/native_parse/prj.conf. Note: configure-abort vs proceed differs by recipe (west workspace vs cmake -DZEPHYR_MODULES); the symbol-level breakage is recipe-independent.
